<summary>
Task: Anonymize /root/paper{1,2,3}.pdf by redacting authorship-revealing info (names, affiliations, emails, arXiv IDs, venue info, funding grants that identify authors) and save to /root/redacted/paper{1,2,3}.pdf.

Turn 1: Listed papers (paper1.pdf 6.2MB/23p, paper2.pdf 218KB/5p, paper3.pdf 1.2MB/12p) and made /root/redacted dir.

Turn 2: Extracted first page text of all three papers. Identified authors/affiliations:
- Paper 1 "VERA" (Preprint): Yueqian Lin, Zhengmian Hu, Qinsi Wang, Yudong Liu, Hengfan Zhang, Jayakumar Subramanian, Nikos Vlassis, Hai "Helen" Li, Yiran Chen — Duke University; Adobe. Correspondence emails yueqian.lin@duke.edu, zhengmianh@adobe.com.
- Paper 2 "ACE-Opencpop/KiSing": Jiatong Shi, Yueqian Lin, Xinyi Bai, Keyi Zhang, Yuning Wu, Yuxun Tang, Yifeng Yu, Qin Jin, Shinji Watanabe — CMU, Duke Kunshan, Cornell, Multimodal Art Projection Community, Renmin University of China, Georgia Tech. Email jiatongs@cs.cmu.edu.
- Paper 3 "SPEECHPRUNE": Yueqian Lin, Yuzhe Fu, Jingyang Zhang, Yudong Liu, Jianyi Zhang, Jingwei Sun, Hai Li, Yiran Chen — Duke University. Email yl768@duke.edu.

Turn 3: Regex sweep for arXiv IDs/emails/venue. Found paper1 self-arXiv banner "arXiv:2509.26542v1 [eess.AS] 30 Sep 2025". Paper2 footer shows "Interspeech 2024, 1-5 September 2024, Kos, Greece" and DOI "10.21437/Interspeech.2024-33". Paper3 footer shows "ICML Workshop on Machine Learning for Audio, Vancouver, Canada. Copyright 2025 by the author(s)." plus NSF 2112562 and ARO W911NF-23-2-0224 grants.

Turn 4–7: Located References sections (paper1 p9, paper2 p4, paper3 p4) and paper2 Acknowledgements on p3 listing grant IDs (CIS210014, IRI120008P, NSF #2138259/#2138286/#2138307/#2137603/#2138296, NSFC 62072462) and names Shengyuan Xu, Pengcheng Zhu. Paper1 has no separate acknowledgements. Paper2 venue/DOI in first-page footer confirmed.

Turn 8: Created /root/redact.py using PyMuPDF. Strategy: find_references_page() locates the References heading and skips all pages ≥ that index (so self-citations in refs are preserved but pre-ref content is scrubbed). For each pre-ref page, iterates over literal patterns, uses page.search_for + add_redact_annot(fill=black) + apply_redactions. Also verifies page count preserved and ≥70% text retained. Pattern lists per paper cover all authors, affiliations, emails, self arXiv IDs, venue strings, DOI, funding IDs, and named individuals in acknowledgements. Guarded against too-generic "Qin" by using "Qin Jin"/"Qin\nJin" instead.

Turn 9: Ran redact.py successfully. Retention: paper1 99.7%, paper2 98.5%, paper3 99.1%. Verification passed for all three.

Turn 10: Inspected redacted page 0s. Author lists, affiliations, emails, correspondence, arXiv banner mostly gone. Paper1 banner still shows "[eess.AS] 30 Sep 2025" fragment. Paper2 venue/DOI removed. Paper3 headers cleaned except author list letters gone; funding text partially.

Turn 11: Leak-scan across pre-references pages. Paper1 and paper2 clean of monitored keywords. Paper3 still leaks "W911NF" (ARO grant). Paper2 acknowledgements section is well-redacted (grants and thanked names blanked).

Turn 12: Confirmed exact residual strings: paper1 has literal "arXiv:2509.26542v1 [eess.AS] 30 Sep 2025" line (the [eess.AS] and date not yet in pattern list). Paper3 funding text "NSF 2112562 and ARO W911NF-23-2-0224" spans a line break (W911NF-23-2-\n0224), so the literal "ARO W911NF-23-2-0224" pattern couldn't match the split form.

Turn 13: Confirmed paper3 still contains "ARO", "W911NF-23-2-", and "0224" after redaction, while "NSF"/"NSF 2112562"/"Canada"/"Copyright"/"ICML"/"Vancouver"/"Workshop"/"Machine Learning for Audio" already removed.

Turn 14: Added "[eess.AS]" and "30 Sep 2025" to paper1_patterns to catch the residual arXiv banner tokens.

Turn 15: Added "W911NF-23-2-0224", "W911NF-23-2-", "W911NF", "0224" to paper3_patterns to catch the line-broken ARO grant form.

Status at end of window: redact.py updated but not re-run yet. Next round needs to re-execute the script and re-verify that (a) paper1 banner residuals ([eess.AS], date) are gone, (b) paper3 W911NF/0224 fragments are gone, (c) retention and page counts still pass, and (d) no other leaks remain. Output files at /root/redacted/paper{1,2,3}.pdf currently exist from the first run but need to be regenerated.
</summary>
